name: io.github.buzzer/imap-mcp
title: IMAP Mail
description: Read and search IMAP mailboxes and create drafts. Sending and deleting are not possible.

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: IMAP server host name (IMAPS), e.g. imap.example.com

environmentVariables.name: MAIL_USER
environmentVariables.description: IMAP login, usually the mail address

environmentVariables.name: MAIL_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: IMAP password; an app-specific password where the provider requires one

environmentVariables.name: MAIL_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: Own sender address, if it differs from the login

environmentVariables.name: MAIL_FROM_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Display name used as sender of drafts

environmentVariables.name: MAIL_ALIASES
environmentVariables.description: Additional allowed sender addresses, comma-separated; *@example.com allows a whole domain

environmentVariables.name: DRAFTS_FOLDER
environmentVariables.description: Drafts folder, if it is not detected automatically

environmentVariables.name: MARK_READ_ON_READ
environmentVariables.description: read_message marks every message it returns as read

environmentVariables.name: DRAFT_UNREAD
environmentVariables.description: Store new drafts as unread, so they stand out in the mailbox

environmentVariables.name: BCC_SELF
environmentVariables.description: Add the sender address as Bcc to every draft
